input.goal: Create from scratch a single self-contained index.html: full-screen HTML5 Canvas Boids flocking simulation (separation, alignment, cohesion) with a glassmorphism HUD and controls.
constraints: Single file index.html with inline <style> and <script>; zero external dependencies (no CDN, no external fonts, no imports).
Zero JavaScript errors or console errors.
Canvas id="sim" fills the whole viewport (resizes on window resize), background color #070b14, body margin 0, no scrollbars.
Boids follow classic rules: separation, alignment, cohesion, with max speed and screen wrap-around; drawn as small triangles oriented along velocity.
Simulation starts PAUSED with at least 40 boids (use 60) already drawn and visible on the canvas.

Expose window.app = { boids: Array of {x,y,vx,vy}, running: boolean, speed: number, frame: number (integer count of simulation steps), fps: number, play(), pause(), toggle(), step(), reset(), addBoid(x,y) }.
Initial state: app.running === false, app.speed === 1, app.frame === 0, app.boids.length === 60.
HUD element id="hud" with glassmorphism style: semi-transparent background rgba, backdrop-filter: blur(...), border 1px rgba white, border-radius, positioned fixed top-left over the canvas.
HUD shows: span id="fps" (FPS number), span id="count" (number of boids, equal to app.boids.length), span id="speedVal" (current speed formatted with 1 decimal, e.g. 1.0).
Button id="playBtn" toggles play/pause; its text is exactly "Play" when paused (initially) and "Pause" when running.
Button id="stepBtn" with text "Step": advances simulation exactly one step (app.frame += 1) and redraws; works while paused.
Button id="resetBtn" with text "Reset": regenerates 60 random boids, sets app.frame = 0, pauses (running=false, playBtn text "Play").
Input type=range id="speed" min=0.5 max=3.0 step=0.1 value=1; on input it sets app.speed to the numeric value and updates #speedVal. Speed multiplies boid movement per step.

Clicking on the canvas (mousedown/click on #sim) adds a new boid at the click position with random velocity (app.boids.length increases by 1) and redraws even when paused; clicks on HUD controls must not add boids.
Render loop uses requestAnimationFrame always (to update FPS and draw); simulation only advances when running.

Ho creato `index.html` tramite Tandem e il job è stato accettato: tutti i controlli automatici in Chromium sono passati, dopo una riparazione fatta in locale. Non ho aperto il file né l'ho provato a mano.

I controlli hanno verificato:
- **Avvio:** sfondo `#070b14`, canvas a tutto schermo, simulazione in pausa con 60 boids e pulsante che mostra "Play".
- **HUD:** effetto vetro sfocato, con FPS, numero di boids e velocità.
- **Controlli:**
  - Step avanza di un solo passo.
  - Il click sul canvas aggiunge un boid.
  - Lo slider va da 0.5 a 3.0 e cambia la velocità.
  - Play avvia il movimento e il pulsante diventa "Pause".
  - Reset rigenera i boids e rimette in pausa.
- **Dipendenze:** non vengono caricati script o fogli di stile esterni.

L'assenza di errori JavaScript era tra i requisiti dati a Tandem, ma nessun test la controlla in modo esplicito.
